purpose: Correct the acquisition control contradiction exposed by the completed c137 ensemble without relabeling any frozen outcome and without granting gameplay-mechanism credit to a recording report.

observed_control_failure.retail_behavior: A natural life loss is transient: the retail game deducts a life and automatically starts a replacement board before the old ten-second quiescent-loss confirmation can complete.
observed_control_failure.detector_failure: The frozen recorder therefore times out after observing later replacement boards instead of certifying the first loss transition.
observed_control_failure.acceptance_contradiction: The frozen recorder closes every non-win outcome through retail_window_close while its PASS predicate requires retail_ui, so a natural_loss result could not pass even if detected.
observed_control_failure.synthetic_test_gap: Existing natural-loss fixtures combine a ten-second quiescent terminal state with retail_ui and therefore do not exercise the integrated retail transition.

transport_scope_requirements: raw DMO path, byte count, and SHA-256 bind exactly to the frozen report
zero process-memory writes in recorder, main-thread receipt, RNG monitor, and MTRand trace
natural uncontrolled RNG with no seed override
verified retail-window main thread and matching process/thread identities
MTRand hardware trace status PASS with restored breakpoint and exact trace SHA-256
normal retail process exit code 0 through either retail_ui or retail_window_close
version 2 expected_outcome natural_loss, gameplay_policy idle, zero gameplay actions and swaps
frozen report status INCOMPLETE and gameplay outcome timeout remain unchanged
frozen_corrections.future_recorder_fix: Represent natural loss as an update-coherent loss-to-restart transition receipt and make the allowed normal exit path outcome-specific; do not require a terminal state to persist for ten seconds.

implementation_order: add fail-closed bounded-authentic-capture validation and negative tests
thread an explicit bounded-capture opt-in through source-bound global and CRT anchor loaders and plan preparation
retain strict certifying-outcome validation as the default and for all Fidelity Gate credit
normalize c137a1 only by the already-proven duplicate startup registry-read removal
prepare a source-bound c137a1 replay plan from its exact RNG monitor and MTRand trace
run a compact diagnostic replay to localize the first natural loss transition
freeze a fixed formal window before collecting two full-state native replays
audit recurrence and simulator difference before requesting natural_loss Gate credit

decision_rules.source_selection: Use c137a1 first because run order was frozen before outcomes; use c137a2 then c137a3 only on a declared technical failure, never because their gameplay result looks preferable.
